title: Nutty Crumbly Syrian Hind Shank Tagine
description: A festive, nutty, crumbly tagine featuring tender sousvide hind shank, dried fruit, and a toasted nut crumble topping.

ingredients.name: Spices
ingredients.amount: 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp coriander, ½ tsp cinnamon

instructions: Preheat your sous‑vide water bath to 180 °F (82 °C).

In a vacuum‑seal bag, combine the hind shank, olive oil, diced onion, minced garlic, cumin, coriander, cinnamon, salt, pepper, and vegetable broth. Add the chopped apricots and figs, then seal the bag.
Cook the sealed bag in the sous‑vide bath for 36 hours (2160 minutes).
While the shank cooks, toast the almonds, walnuts, and sesame seeds in a dry pan until fragrant, then crush them into coarse crumbs.
After the sous‑vide time is up, remove the bag, discard the liquid, and pat the shank dry with paper towels.
Place the shank in a baking dish and evenly scatter the toasted nut crumble topping over the top.
Bake in a preheated oven at 400 °F (200 °C) for 10–12 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown.
Let the shank rest for 5 minutes before slicing. Serve with warm pita or a bed of couscous.
